decisions.reason: Although related to the firm's shop-hosting know-how, the Magento-specific template is peripheral to its strongest hosting and support capabilities, so resources are better shifted to core services and higher-learning projects.
A responsive website template still fits the firm's CMS, hosting, and agency-service knowledge base, allowing it to absorb customer feedback and keep it as a complementary offer.
Premium customer support lies at the center of the firm's established operational routines and expert-service strengths, so it is highly likely to be retained.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's in-house R&D and platform operations, giving it strong capacity to improve and commercialize the product further.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship product tightly aligned with the firm's core platform, agency focus, and growth direction, making withdrawal unlikely.
